description: Issue #286: the optional query preserves carried errors when selecting clean witnesses.

%stage before
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text bad
%emits $ :: T
%rule bad "t" :: T
%error "earlier"
%stage main
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text [+T] [+U] T
%check any-reading #·_<_Elided>
%conditions U ⊆ $.tags, $.preceding-element.local-readings
%warning "dirty local reading exists"
